record.label: 11.8-fold reduction in spacetime cost
record.statement: The reported spacetime cost $Q\cdot\mathcal T$ is lower by a factor of 11.8 when compared with the momentum-space baseline of Appendix G.2.
record.boundary: The factor of 11.8 is the ratio of the reconstructed baseline cost, about $5.42\times10^{15}$ per run, to the proved upper bound of about $4.59\times10^{14}$ per run.
